description: This script is a test suite for Git's receive package limits, testing how different input and transfer limits affect Git push operations and their internal behavior.

methods.name: validate_store_type
methods.description: Validates the type of store ('index' or 'unpack') based on the actual object count output.

methods.name: test_pack_input_limit
methods.description: Runs a series of tests to verify behavior under different receive input size limits and unpack limits.
